title: No validation of IPv6 address semantics in LOADng messages
description: from_bytes methods accept any 16 bytes as IPv6 addresses without validating semantic validity. Unspecified (::), loopback (::1), and multicast addresses are accepted. Add validation or document that callers must validate.
close_reason: Fixed: Added IPv6 address validation to LOADng from_bytes methods. Rejects unspecified (::), loopback (::1), and multicast (ff00::/8) addresses. Added is_unspecified() to Addr type, InvalidAddress error variant, and validation tests.
